summary: Console > Optimize > Suggestions shows "Insufficient telemetry" despite active traffic (telemetry freshness incorrectly marked stale)
environment: prod (us-east-1 control plane; tenant region: eu-west)
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that the Console > Optimize > Suggestions page shows the empty/blocked state: "Insufficient telemetry to generate suggestions" (and/or "We need more recent usage data to estimate savings") even though they have steady production traffic.

Customer impact:
- Prevents usage of Suggestions beta during onboarding / weekly cost optimization reviews.
- Customer reports active production usage (>10M tokens/day) across multiple routes.
- Trust impact: customer is concerned Suggestions is "not working" / misconfigured.

Environment:
- Tenant: Hawthorne Analytics (Dedicated)
- Console: Production
- Observed primarily when filtering Suggestions to region eu-west

Steps to reproduce (as provided by customer + Support):
1) Log into Console (prod)
2) Navigate: Optimize → Suggestions (beta)
3) Observe banner/empty state: "Insufficient telemetry" / "Not enough recent data"
4) Confirm tenant has traffic (Usage dashboard shows requests/tokens in last 1h)

Expected:
Suggestions list populates (or at minimum shows "No suggestions available" without the telemetry blocker) when traffic exists.

Actual:
Telemetry blocker displayed. No suggestions shown.

Notes / initial hypothesis:
Suggestions service suppresses suggestions if cost baseline telemetry is older than freshness threshold (per guardrails). Suspect baseline freshness calculation is wrong for this tenant/region (marked stale when it is not), or ingestion delay preventing baseline materialization despite usage appearing elsewhere in Console.

Support attachments / links:
- Customer screenshot: empty state + timestamp (attached in Jira)
- Internal: Console BFF logs show suggestions response reason_code=INSUFFICIENT_TELEMETRY (request_id included in comments)

Requested action:
1) Verify telemetry freshness metrics for tenant + route/model + region.
2) Confirm whether token metering baselines are updated within freshness SLO.
3) If freshness miscomputed, patch and backfill; confirm customer sees Suggestions populate.

They confirmed steady prod traffic; Usage dashboard shows last-hour tokens. Assigning to telemetry for investigation. Customer asks if we need to enable additional telemetry settings on their side.

2026-02-07 10:02 PT — Rachel Kim (Enterprise CS): Adding context: this is blocking their beta onboarding call next week. They’re specifically trying to evaluate caching suggestions for /chat/completions in eu-west. They are sensitive to any perception that savings estimates are "made up" or unavailable.

2026-02-07 10:41 PT — Logan Wright (Telemetry/Analytics): Looking. First check: suggestions-service returns INSUFFICIENT_TELEMETRY when baseline_age_hours > threshold OR missing metering rows for route/model/region. 2026-02-07 11:26 PT — Logan Wright (Telemetry/Analytics): Found: baseline table has data, but freshness computation marks eu-west slices as stale (age ~29–31h) even though ingestion shows events in last 2h. Metric telemetry_baseline_last_updated_at for eu-west is not advancing; us-east slices are fine. Suspect region dimension mismatch in aggregation job (writes coming in as region="eu-west-1" but downstream expects "eu-west").

2026-02-07 12:10 PT — Nadia Rahman (Cost attribution & metering): Confirming mismatch. The metering pipeline standardized to "eu-west-1" last week; suggestions baseline job still joins on legacy region enum. This would make "fresh" events fail to update the baseline row in the expected partition, while other Console usage views (which read the raw fact table) still show traffic.

2026-02-07 12:22 PT — Logan Wright (Telemetry/Analytics): Creating/Linking ENG-2403 for fix. Plan: accept both region values in baseline job + backfill last 48h. Interim mitigation: temporarily relax freshness check for affected tenants? Prefer fix + backfill; should resolve within 24h.

2026-02-07 12:47 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Replying to customer: we’ve identified an issue on our side with how "recent usage" is detected for eu-west and are working on a fix/backfill. No action required on their side. Will update by EOD tomorrow with ETA.

2026-02-08 09:35 PT — Logan Wright (Telemetry/Analytics): Patch is up in staging; baseline updates now advancing for both eu-west and eu-west-1. Running validation queries: expected baseline_age_hours < 2 for Hawthorne traffic. If good, will ship to prod + trigger backfill.

2026-02-08 14:20 PT — Logan Wright (Telemetry/Analytics): Deployed to prod. Triggered backfill job for last 72h for affected tenants/regions. Monitoring: suggestions-service stale_estimate_rate decreasing; expected to normalize once backfill completes (~2–3h). Related PRs: redwood/pr-18657 (baseline job), redwood/pr-18731 (better UI error copy; not required but nice-to-have).

2026-02-08 17:06 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Customer rechecked: Suggestions no longer shows telemetry blocker; they see 6 suggestions (mostly caching + batching). They noted savings numbers changed vs yesterday, which we explained is expected as baselines backfilled. They asked for a brief note we can share with their team about why it happened; I provided a short summary (region label mismatch) and that no customer data was exposed.

2026-02-10 08:12 PT — Dev Patel (Support): Closing loop. Root cause confirmed: region enum mismatch caused baseline freshness to appear stale for eu-west slices, triggering "Insufficient telemetry" gating despite active traffic. Fix deployed + backfill completed. Marking Resolved. Follow-up remains tracked in ENG-2403 to add a canary/alert for region-dimension drift and to tighten freshness SLO dashboards.
resolution: Resolved with backend fix to telemetry baseline aggregation (accept both legacy and new region identifiers) + backfill of last 72h. Suggestions page now displays for affected tenant/region; no customer action required.
